name: Tabletop Tools
tagline: Dice, timers and buzzers for board game night
description:
Tabletop Tools stands in for the small pieces that always go missing from a board game box. It rolls dice in every usual shape, from a D3 up to a D100, runs a timer with a sound at the end, gives one to four players their own buzzer for quiz rounds, and shuffles a list of names into a random order when you need to decide who goes first.

There are two extras for puzzle games as well: a ROT13 encoder for hiding and revealing clues, and a converter between decimal, binary and hexadecimal.

Nothing to set up and no account to make. Open it, tap the tool you need, put the phone back on the table.
